sections: S&P monthly chart – Monthly officially closes Monday, but generally the trend is still up, and a higher low around 525 makes lots of sense if pullback continues. 20SMA, prior highs, also ~14.5% drawdown which is on par for the average.

S&P weekly chart – Clean rejection of the weekly double top neck line for a lower high confirming the trend change. Anchored VWAPs rejecting. Fib 38.2 rejecting... Bearish engulfer on the structure. Generally doesn't look great for bulls.

S&P daily chart – Markets made some mild improvements early in the week with the break and close over the daily 200, but tariff news and stagflation fears took it all back on the trend line breakdown. Daily trend remains down and seeking lower highs is the base case walking forward.

S&P hourly chart – The buyers failed to hold the do or die zone low which was also the gap fill reversal level to the prior Friday. Clear spots for lower highs to emerge. I might entertain counter trend longs over 559.75 as scalps since it would be a thin structure retrace.

Market internals – Market internals still don't suggest that new money buyers are getting involved in this market. Monday was more of a short squeeze, and Friday was confirmation that sellers still hold the strength.

Market profile – Single prints from A/B period align with the thin structure retrace mentioned above. Lower highs that are sustained below the 5725 area are most bearish for the /ES. If price gets above, mind the poor high from Thursday.
